_comment: Hand-authored. Stage clear, key award, the ship's exit, the final-score screen and the sprite-sheet loaders, bank 7 $F493-$F771 (inline data, tables and the launch code are claimed elsewhere). The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: Read the pads, then the pause check
regions.description: Slot $C16B; called once per game-loop pass ($FF92), by the launch flight loop, the stage-clear loops and the key-panel wait. $D64C reads the pads (so $F5/$F6 hold new presses, $F7/$F8 held buttons); if $30 bit 7 is clear (not a demo) it jumps to the pause/status routine $E4B3, whose RTS returns to the caller.

regions.name: Demo: a new Start ends it
regions.description: In a demo ($30 bit 7) a new Start press ($F5 bit 4) jumps to $FF4A (the game's start-up, i.e. leaves the attract mode); anything else returns. The pause routine is not reachable in a demo.

regions.name: Which key does this corridor award?
regions.description: In: $51. Out: A = the key number (Z set when none). Corridor 0 and every corridor from 11 up: 0; corridors 1-10: $F6DA[corridor] (the table at $F6DB, read one byte early because the index starts at 1) = 1 2 3 4 0 5 0 6 7 0. Called by the stage-clear code only.

regions.name: Scripted ship entrance on the cleared-corridor gate screen
regions.description: Called from $EC4C when the labyrinth's special screen type $51 is 5 (the gate once its corridor is cleared; $EC43). Sets slot 0 to type $81 (the player's type $01 with bit 7 set), metasprite $50, flags $03, x $70, y $C8, y velocity and target $FB (-5), the state counter $07E8 = 2, then (bank 6 selected) loops one frame at a time - pads ($F493) and one object-loop pass ($8000) - until $07E8 reaches 0. RUN from a corridor savestate (so the room is not the real one): it returned after 420 frames with $07E8 stepping 2 -> 3 -> 0 and the ship ending near (152, 202). What the type-$81 ship does with its state counter, and the screen it plays on, were not worked out (LEAD).

regions.name: STAGE CLEAR: the jingle
regions.description: Entered by JSR from the stage-end code $ECBD (corridor 21 at $ECC7, 22 at $ECE1, corridors 0-20 at $ECE7 - 1-20 after marking the corridor cleared, $EFBA). Plays sound $17 (the clear jingle; id not looked up) unless the corridor is 0 or 22, then selects bank 6.

regions.name: Stage clear: stop the spawning, run the scroll down to a stop
regions.description: $60 low two bits cleared (the spawn script stops), $A0 bit 0 cleared (the end-of-stage request that brought us here), then loops: speed target $BA/$BB = 0, the scroll step and speed ramp ($E66A: 2/256 a frame), one full game-loop pass ($FF8B: the ship, shots and enemies keep running) until the speed $B8/$B9 is 0. RUN: it takes speed / 2 frames - 19 for corridor 4 (speed 38), 20 for 21, 1,264 for corridor 0 (speed 2,528, the Defense System's stage).

regions.name: Stage clear: clear the objects, then the key if there is one
regions.description: $EA68 removes objects 1-23. A TGL game ($30 bit 1) goes straight to the flight at $F5DE; otherwise $F4A7 gives the corridor's key and none (corridors 0, 5, 7, 10, 11 and up) goes there too.

regions.name: Stage clear: award the key
regions.description: Y = the key number: bit (key - 1) is ORed into the key inventory $04B0 (the mask table at $EFD8, read from $EFD7 + key), sound $36 plays, $19:$18 = $15C0 (the pattern-table address the key's icon is built at) and A = the key number goes to the icon builder: far call to bank 2 slot $8006 (-> $8212; the 3 inline bytes follow at $F566). RUN, corridor 4: $04B0 went $00 -> $08 at frame 18, sound $36 at 18.

regions.name: Key panel: paint a black 10 x 3 block of metatile $20
regions.description: Cells x = $30, $40 ... $C0 by y = $40, $50, $60 (pixel positions, 10 columns x 3 rows) are each filled with metatile $20 through $FAB7 (the block-redraw routine behind $FA96: it adds the scroll $A6 to y, wrapping at $F0, converts the position to a PPU address and queues the tiles; in a corridor, $30 bit 6, it skips the labyrinth's class write). The result is a plain black rectangle over the corridor (picture from the run).

regions.name: Key panel: the icon's cell
regions.description: One more $FAB7 call with metatile $5C at (x $B0, y $50): the cell the key's icon sprite sits in.

regions.name: Key panel: the text position and the message
regions.description: $19:$18 = (x $40, y $50 + scroll, wrapped and masked to a tile row) converted by $FA6B to a PPU address, then JSR $D53F with the inline string ' YOU GOT KEY' (12 characters, at $F5CC): the line is written at column 8 of the panel's middle row. RUN: the picture shows the black panel, YOU GOT KEY and the key icon.

regions.name: Key panel: hold for 40 game-loop passes
regions.description: LDY #$28 / JSR $FF8B: 40 passes (43 frames from the award to the flight in the run), then falls into the flight.

regions.name: The ship flies away: set it up
regions.description: Slot 0 becomes type 5 (the flight ship), metasprite 1, $0560, tile base $06C8, phase $0638 and the y fraction cleared. Corridors 0 and 22: phase 1 at once and velocity/target 0 (it will climb); every other corridor: phase 0, y velocity and target $0668 = $FE, flags $0620 = 5.

regions.name: The ship flies away: phase 0 (normal corridors)
regions.description: Each pass: a game-loop pass ($FF8B, Y = 1), pads, sprite reset ($CDB4), X = 0. Phase 0: when y is below $20 it applies thrust $0C toward the target ($CD12), draws the ship ($CBE8; carry = it has left the screen) and, when it has, steps the phase, y := 0, y fraction and velocity := 0. RUN (corridor 4): the ship climbs at 2 px a frame from y 160, left the top at frame 85 of the flight and re-appeared at y 0 as phase 1.

regions.name: The ship flies away: phase 1
regions.description: Thrust $20 toward the target $0668, draw, and leave the loop when the ship is off the screen. Target $0668 = $FE for normal corridors, so the ship comes in again from the top and DIVES, accelerating (y velocity 3, 6, 7 px a frame; off the bottom 57 frames later); target 0 for corridors 0 and 22, so from its place on the screen it climbs off the top (51 frames in corridor 0).

regions.name: The ship is gone: corridor 0 (and TGL) end here
regions.description: $CE88 finishes the sprites; corridor 0 (and the TGL path from $F6B2) sets $0680 = 1 (landing mode), fades out ($EDD1), turns the screen off ($D4E3) and jumps to the landing tail $F43C: no landing flight. Corridor 22 goes on at $F667, all others at $F6B2.

regions.name: Corridor 22: the final score screen (set-up)
regions.description: Fade out, hide all sprites ($D534: $F8 to every OAM byte), screen off, sound $1F, scroll zeroed ($D4FD), nametable 0 blanked ($E445 with A = $20), wait for the decompressor, then the inline string 'YOUR FINAL SCORE' at PPU $2086.

regions.name: Final score: the fixed trailing zero
regions.description: A second inline string, a single '0' at PPU $20CE: the score is kept in tens, so the screen prints a constant 0 after its six digits.

regions.name: Final score: print the digits, then the ending
regions.description: $19:$18 = $20C8 and $E118 prints the six score digits ($0170-$0175, leading zeros blanked); then the far call to bank 2 slot $8021 (-> $8A69, the ending; it never returns - see the ending notes).

regions.name: Normal corridors: fade out and start the LANDING flight
regions.description: TGL games take $F659 (no flight). Otherwise: fade ($EDD1), bank 5, A = 1 and JMP $F2BB, the launch routine with the mode set to 1 - the landing flight - whose RTS returns to the caller of $F506. RUN: corridor 4 flew from $F6B8 at frame 203 to $F2BB at 211 and the landing finished 352 frames later; **corridor 21 takes the same path and DOES reach the 'entry 0' block**: sound $2D and bank 4 entry 0 ($826D), a landing 1,061 frames long (CORRECTION: the launch-flight notes called this unreached).

regions.name: The ship's exhaust flame
regions.description: $0788 counts frames; tile base $87 = $32 + ($0788 AND 2) (alternating $32 / $34), metasprite $1D drawn with $CC34 at the ship, then $CE88 and back to the loop at $F612. The same flame the launch flight draws.

regions.name: Load the corridor ship's sprite sheet
regions.description: $19:$18 = 0 (PPU $0000), block 5 of bank 2 armed for the decompressor ($D7F9) and waited for. Callers: $ECD0, $F295, $F2BE. RUN.

regions.name: Load the labyrinth ship's sprite sheet
regions.description: Block 4 of bank 2 to PPU $0000. Callers: $EB66 and the landing tail $F468. RUN.

regions.name: Load block $0C of bank 2 to PPU $0740
regions.description: The common sprite tiles of the corridors (what they hold was not drawn). Reached by JMP from $F455 at the end of a launch. RUN.

regions.name: Load the sprite tiles for the selected weapon
regions.description: Block 6 of bank 2 to PPU $0680 always, then by the weapon $3C and its level $3D: tables $F77F (0 none, 1/2 a level threshold, $FF the beam), $F772 (the block) and $F78B (the beam's block by level). RUN, every weapon x level 0-3: no weapon or the Enemy Eraser (12): nothing more; 1 MultiBullets, 4 Bullet Shield, 8 Repeller: block 7 at $0760, but block $0A at $0780 instead at level 3; 6 Fireball the same from level 2; 2 Back Fire and 3 Wave Attack: block $0B at $0760; 5 Grenade: $0A at $0780 and 8 at $0760; 7, 10, 11: block 7 at $0760; 9 Hyper Laser: blocks $1E, $1F, $20 at $0760 for levels 1-3 (none at 0). Callers: $EB69, $ECD3, $F452 and by JMP $F46B.
